skill.summary: convert images into animated video clips with this skill. Works with JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC files up to 200MB. TikTok creators use it for turning still photos...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "AI Image to Video Effect" skill.
- Convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC images (up to 200MB) into animated 1080p MP4 video clips, optimized for social media and TikTok creators.
- Supports basic authentication and automatic backend session management with 100 free credits for new users.
- Direct uploading, timeline editing, and export workflows with detailed error handling.
- Cloud GPU rendering delivers video in about 20-40 seconds; multiple export formats supported.
- User intent automatically mapped to actions like upload, credits check, video export, and editing commands.
